mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines (over any 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 6.5% signals severe labor market distress, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE > 6.5 (over any 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in industrial production and employment indicate a deepening economic contraction, causing equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when both INDPRO and PAYEMS decline (over any 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Housing market downturns (HOUST below 800,000 units) signal broad economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as sector spillovers intensify.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST < 800 (over any 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production indicates weakening economic output, reducing corporate earnings expectations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO declines (over any 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate cuts below 1.0% signal emergency monetary policy intervention, boosting risk appetite and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 1.0 (over any 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Declining retail sales combined with low interest rates indicates weak consumer demand amid accommodative policy, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when RSAFS declines and FEDFUNDS < 1.0 (over any 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Employment declines below 136 million signal accelerating labor market deterioration, causing equity market corrections and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS < 136000 (over any 3-year rolling window).
